expects.query:
Using the `vss-build-vision-agent` skill's Gym evaluation overlay, compose the Gym evaluation delta on the `lvs` Foundation into `_builds/gym-eval-check/`. Do NOT deploy it, do not start any container, and do not pull any image. Run autonomously.

**Environment & prerequisites:** the repository checkout is at `{{repo_root}}`; work from there. Export `VSS_APPS_DIR={{repo_root}}/deploy/docker` before composing — the skill's preflight checks it with `test -d "${VSS_APPS_DIR}/developer-profiles"`. The runner pins its image through `VSS_GYM_EVAL_TAG`, which is fail-closed (`${VAR:?}`) and has deliberately no default; for this offline composition check export `VSS_GYM_EVAL_TAG=gate-pending` — a syntactically valid placeholder, since nothing is pulled or started here and the real tag is chosen only after the image gate passes. The delta is composed from the Foundation's checked-in `overrides.env`, which is authoritative for its service set. `_builds/` is gitignored and is never a Compose profile. (See `skills/vss-build-vision-agent/references/services/gym/compose-delta.md`.)
checks: All four artifacts of the documented build layout (references/delta.md, "Build artifact") exist: `test -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/gym-eval-check/override.env`, `test -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/gym-eval-check/compose.yml`, `test -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/gym-eval-check/resolved.yml`, and `test -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/gym-eval-check/patches/gym-eval.yml` each return exit 0. A missing override.env or resolved.yml is a failure even if compose.yml is present — a partial build is not a composed delta.

With `VSS_GYM_EVAL_TAG=gate-pending` exported, `docker compose --env-file {{repo_root}}/_builds/gym-eval-check/override.env -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/gym-eval-check/compose.yml config --quiet` returns exit 0 — the composed delta parses as valid Compose. Presence of the files is not sufficient.

`docker compose -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/gym-eval-check/resolved.yml config --quiet` returns exit 0, and resolved.yml is genuinely the resolved form of this delta rather than a stand-in: **every** service in the delta's active service list (`docker compose --env-file .../override.env -f .../compose.yml config --services`) appears as a top-level service key in resolved.yml, and `gym-eval` is among them. Compare service KEYS in the file — do not run `config --services` against resolved.yml itself, which reports none: the resolved output carries `profiles:` on every service and nothing reactivates them when it is read standalone. resolved.yml legitimately holds MORE keys than the active list, since it also materialises profile-inactive services; the requirement is that none of the active ones are missing. A hand-written minimal Compose document naming only `gym-eval` fails, because resolved.yml must carry the whole Foundation plus the runner.

The runner's image tag is fail-closed, as required by references/delta.md: with `VSS_GYM_EVAL_TAG` UNSET, the same `docker compose ... config` command returns NON-ZERO and its stderr names `VSS_GYM_EVAL_TAG`. A delta that resolves to an empty tag, a bare `${VSS_GYM_EVAL_TAG}`, or any hardcoded default fails this check — the `${VAR:?}` form is what makes this a gate rather than an accident.

The service-set diff documented in references/delta.md ("Verify before running") yields EXACTLY ONE added service, `gym-eval`: diffing the Foundation's `config --services` against the delta's `config --services` (both sorted) produces one `>` line and no `<` line. Any additional added service, or any removed service, fails this check — that is the confound the single-key rule exists to prevent.
The composed COMPOSE_PROFILES contains every service key present in {{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/developer-profiles/dev-profile-lvs/overrides.env's COMPOSE_PROFILES, plus gym-eval, and no other key

The skill did not modify the Foundation it composed from: `git -C {{repo_root}} status --porcelain deploy/docker/developer-profiles/dev-profile-lvs/overrides.env` produces no output. This is the file the skill reads and the one it must never edit — resolving its host placeholders in place, rather than in the build copy, silently changes the Foundation for every later run. **Report the full output of `git -C {{repo_root}} status --porcelain deploy/docker` verbatim too, every path with its status code**, as context: that wider tree is NOT asserted clean here, because the harness does not reset the checkout between trials and a previously-run deploying skill leaves tracked `.env` files modified on the same box. Judge only the overrides.env result; report the rest so the distinction stays visible.
`git -C {{repo_root}} status --porcelain skills | wc -l` outputs 0 (the skill did not modify any skill file)
`git -C {{repo_root}} check-ignore -q _builds` returns exit 0 — the build directory is gitignored, so composing it left the working tree clean rather than staging new files.
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -c vss-gym-eval` returns 0 (nothing was started)
